role: Declares WorkoutStatsCards (the post-workout statistics-card builder struct split out of FitnessPostSummaryView), plus two small helpers: WorkoutActiveTime (paused-time-free duration from sample offsets) and LocalizedUnit (MeasurementFormatter in the app language).
types: WorkoutStatsCards: struct (@MainActor, not a View) — holds session/settingsManager/track and builds chart/HRR cards via its extension in WorkoutStatsCards+Cards.swift
WorkoutActiveTime: enum — namespace for active (un-paused) duration
LocalizedUnit: enum — unit symbols and measurement strings in the app locale
state: WorkoutStatsCards.settingsManager: SettingsManager (instance let, reference to shared settings)
toplevel: Imports CoreLocation/SwiftUI. WorkoutStatsCards is @MainActor; constructed per access by FitnessPostSummaryView.stats (FitnessPostSummaryView+StatsForwarding.swift:12-14) and by ViewSnapshotTests.makeStats. No globals.

flags.text: LocalizedUnit.formatter re-implements UnitsPreference.measurement (same MeasurementFormatter setup: appLocale, .medium, .providedUnit, fixed fraction digits); two copies of unit formatting to keep in sync.
Type comment says the share sheet reaches elevationSeries and hrrProvenanceLabel through a forwarder; those forwarders have no callers.

units.does: Returns the process-wide units preference by reading UnitsPreferenceStore.current on every access (not cached); that getter reads the App Group suite, falls back to .standard and then writes the legacy value into the suite, defaulting to .auto.
writes: ud:fitness.unitsPreference (App Group suite: the getter copies a legacy .standard value into the suite on read, UnitsPreference.swift:136-139)

units.does: Returns the active (un-paused) duration: the last WorkoutSample's offsetSec when it is > 0, otherwise the wall-clock fallback passed in (may be nil).

branches.effect: true: returns last offset as TimeInterval; false: returns wallClock (nil when the session has no endDate).

flags.text: Only caller is WorkoutStatsCards.activeDuration, whose only callers are avgPaceDisplay (tests only) and estimatedCaloriesDisplay (no callers). The production summary hero instead shows duration and pace from session.duration (endDate − startDate, wall clock incl. pauses) in heroDurationLabel/heroPaceLabel, so the paused-time correction this type exists for never reaches the user; a paused workout shows an inflated duration and a slower average pace.

units.does: Returns the localized unit symbol (e.g. 'km', 'mi') for a Unit using the app-locale MeasurementFormatter with 0 fraction digits.
Formats value+unit as a localized measurement string (e.g. '12.3 km/h') with the given fixed fraction digits (default 0), in the app locale, in the provided unit.
Builds a new MeasurementFormatter each call: locale and number-formatter locale = LanguageManager.appLocale, unitStyle .medium, unitOptions .providedUnit, min=max fraction digits = fractionDigits.
